welcome.title: Welcome to TPA
welcome.subtitle: Trains, Planes and Automobiles (and Boats)
lines: A live map of UK transport: planes, trains, buses and road traffic.
Free for everyone, always. No adverts and no subscriptions.
This is a test version. Live layers show real data; anything marked MOCK is a pretend example.

tip.label: Buy me a coffee
tip.note: Completely optional. TPA stays free either way.

credits.text: Bus data sourced via the Department for Transport's Bus Open Data Service (BODS).

Train movements from Network Rail open data feeds (exact wording to follow Network Rail's reply). Station locations: DfT NaPTAN, Open Government Licence. Junction and timing-point locations: YA TIPLOC list (Network Rail and NaPTAN data under OGL; woodpecker and GB Railway Data under CC BY-SA 4.0). Trains are shown at the last station or junction they reported, not by GPS.
Aircraft positions from ADSB.lol (Open Database License).
